events.summary: Urza and Barrin found the Tolarian Academy on Tolaria to research and experiment against the Phyrexians.
events.quote: when Urza and Barrin established the Tolarian Academy to intensively research and experiment in their escalating conflict against the Phyrexians

events.summary: As the Academy expands, Jhoira and Rayne assume chancellorship from Urza.
events.quote: as it expanded others such as Jhoira , and Barrin's wife Rayne , assumed chancellorship

events.summary: The first Academy is destroyed in the Tolarian Temporal Disaster after 22 years.
events.quote: This first version of the academy would last for 22 years until it was destroyed in the Tolarian Temporal Disaster .
